title: Mergers, acquisitions and control
author: equity and valuation specialist
acceptance: Pending independent coordinator acceptance after accepted c08. Specialist changed no canonical or shared state.
review_type: Full original manuscript, four worked cases, all eight exact exercise prompts and solutions, answered teaching and retention, all four lab assets, focused checker and scoped primary-source audit. Author review is not an independent human review.

coverage.outcome: Evaluate acquisition economics and distinguish synergy from wealth transfers.

canonical.Purchase price: Market/conditional operating and ordinary-equity bridges; excess cash, holdings, debt and other claims; ordinary cash consideration versus transaction operating-value convention; sources/uses and economic versus financeable price limits.
canonical.synergy: Separate baseline, feasible control counterfactual and buyer-specific combination cash; finite after-tax receipts, required investment, integration and fees; complete net shareholder surplus and wider claimant/social-value limits.
canonical.integration: Dated finite benefit/cost register, operational mechanism and implementation ownership, realization scaling with costs held fixed, one-year benefit delay, milestones and funding feasibility.
canonical.control premiums: Control improvement versus an observed bid premium; baseline expectation, rumor/reference-price timing, competing offers and sample/payment selection. No universal premium is inferred.
canonical.financing: Full cash and share-deal sources/uses; fair new debt, target debt retirement, retained old debt/preferred claims, zero excess closing cash and a binding-capable commitment. Principal is not a synergy.
canonical.dilution versus value: Endogenous fixed-ratio post-deal value, all shareholder wealth, participation proofs and fixed-value share equation; EPS-positive/value-negative example with full solutions; goodwill versus economic gains.

coverage.prerequisites: Read accepted c08 in full during earlier completed peer audit; c02 cash/claim boundary reread; c03 and c07 authored and accepted earlier. Current canonical c09 and exact closing assignment reread before work.
coverage.teaching: Answered board explanation comparing 230 cash with twelve shares quoted at 240 but actually worth 1700/7; distinguishes EPS and goodwill.
coverage.retention: Four answered reconstructions: cash gains, stock participation, other-creditor transfer and funding ceiling.
coverage.lab: Four-file standard-library exact rational model; original Alder/Bracken inputs plus separate Fenwick/Lowbank EPS and owner signing cases.
coverage.ownership: Only c09 chapter, c09-prefixed four assets, c09 checker and c09 source/author records edited. No shared files, publishing or child agents.

reasoning_checks: The same dated ordinary-equity perimeter is used in baseline values, consideration, financing and wealth. Bracken preferred 10 remains a separate claim; debt 60 is retired once; both excess cash balances are used once. Claims are supplied fair values, not assumed to equal arbitrary book balances.

Control PV 22.5 is achievable without this buyer and needs no new investment. Combination cash PV 90 requires the separate immediate capacity investment 30. Integration 12 now plus 4.4 at T1 has PV 16; immediate deal fee is 6.5. All incremental receipt and tax dates are explicit, finite and original.

Cash taxes are supplied directly, with no extra capital deduction or financing shield. Postfunding operating value 978.5 contains the already-funded future benefits and only future integration PV 4; immediate 30/12/6.5 outlays reduce closing cash via sources/uses instead of being deducted twice.

All old investor classes conserve value: total old-holder wealth rises from 960 to 1020, while new debt has a matching contribution and value. S is value available to ordinary owners under unchanged other claims, not an unconditional social welfare or resource-gain claim.

Cash buyer gain 20 and seller gain 40 sum to net S 60. The 250 economic ceiling is distinct from 231.5 financeable consideration under a 250 borrowing commitment. Baseline borrowing is 248.5, giving only 1.5 slack.

Stock consideration issues twelve thousand equal-rights new shares and cancels the ten thousand target shares. Postshares are 42, combined common equity 850 and price 425/21. Seller value is endogenous at 1700/7; old buyers receive 4250/7. Non-consideration cash uses still need 18.5 of borrowing.

Participation interval is derived from each groups actual post-deal fraction; positive-value conditions precede division. The fixed-value equation requires 0 <= Q < combined equity. Equal gains under a cash-equivalent share offer rely on the stipulated unchanged net financing side effects.

Realization sensitivity scales combination receipts and taxes only, retaining all investment and integration costs. Cash and share gains conserve each changed S. The twelve-share offer shares marginal S in fractions 5/7 and 2/7, but baseline price allocation can still make it worse for buyers.
Delay moves only buyer-specific receipts and taxes one year, reducing their PV from 90 to 900/11. No terminal continuation is invented and the original fixed-cost dates remain in place.

Signing is a distinct date and an explicitly supplied linear owner planning criterion. Physical probability weighting is not called an identified market price. Conditional later-date gains, immediate advisory cost and external failure costs reconcile; interparty break fees would cancel in the total.

EPS counterexample has supplied independently valued business claims, a beginning-year close and a full common-earnings period. Zero net combination value can coexist with positive EPS accretion and buyer wealth loss; the combined PE is recomputed rather than freezing the buyers old PE.

Accounting goodwill is a stipulated allocation residual. Examples distinguish it from target premium, net synergy and buyer NPV. Official IFRS overview is used only within its scope, without importing historical purchase/pooling or universal tax rules.

All eight exact prompts contain the data and method needed for their solutions. The final exercise provides explicit criteria for open evidence critique. Teach-back and retention have substantive answers and do not introduce untaught computational requirements.

exercise_audit.result: Standalone equity 290, price 58/3, transaction operating value 400, premium 40 or 4/29; lender claim distinguished from seller proceeds.
75% realization gives S 75/2 and buyer loss 5/2; cash break-even 7/9. One-year combination delay gives S 570/11 and buyer gain 130/11.
240 debt commitment leaves gap 17/2; financeable offer 443/2 gives seller gain 63/2 and buyer gain 57/2; economic ceiling remains 250.
13 shares give price 850/43, buyer gain -300/43, seller gain 2880/43 and unchanged total gain 60; buyer ceiling 25/2 shares.
Fixed-value consideration 230 requires 345/31 shares, ratio 69/62 and price 62/3. Old-price shortcut transfers 19550/83 instead of 230.
Seven-share EPS 10/9, accretion 1/9; price 500/27, buyer wealth 10000/27 and loss 800/27. Conflicting signals occur for 5 < x < 10.
Goodwill 35, seller gain 20 and buyer loss 8; total gain 12. Three comparison bases and unsupported director inference explained.
At success probability 1/4: buyer signing -23/21, target 170/21, total 7. Four-plus evidence criteria and probability-versus-market-pricing distinction answered.

methods: Backward recursion reconstructs all three annual PVs independently of the lab discounting helper.
Signed closing ledger and surviving-claim balance independently reconcile both payment policies and old-investor wealth.
Ownership fractions independently give stock price/gains; participation endpoints and equivalent-value offer solve original equations.
Exact independent anchors cover all sensitivity rows, delayed dates, EPS, signing and every determinate exercise answer.
Consequential variants report real financing gaps and empty participation intervals, retain costs at zero realization and allow valid probability endpoints.
Nine meaningful invalid domains are rejected with explicit ValueError checks that persist under Python -O.
